offering_description.value: Manufactures and markets branded shelf-stable and frozen foods for grocery retailers, distributors and foodservice customers.

primary_products.value: Frozen and canned vegetables; spices and seasonings; baking ingredients; hot cereals; sauces and condiments; canned beans; snacks

items.detail: Grocery retailers, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, wholesalers, distributors and foodservice operators

end_markets.value: Consumer packaged foods; grocery retail; foodservice

items.detail: Sales of packaged foods to retailers, distributors and foodservice customers
Processes agricultural ingredients into packaged foods sold to retail and foodservice channels
Owns and markets food brands, with some production supplied by contract manufacturers

geography_served.detail: Primarily the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, with additional international sales

company_size.value: Large packaged food producer with a broad brand portfolio, manufacturing facilities across the United States and national retail distribution

specialization.detail: Shelf-stable and frozen food categories sharing grocery distribution, brand management and food manufacturing capabilities

items.detail: Sales to grocery chains, mass merchants, warehouse clubs and foodservice accounts
Supermarkets, mass merchants and other retailers sell packaged foods to consumers
Independent food brokers support sales to retail and wholesale accounts

regulatory_exposure.detail: Food manufacturing is subject to FDA food safety, labeling and allergen rules, applicable USDA requirements, and environmental and workplace safety regulations

notes: Descriptions reflect model knowledge; recent brand divestitures or acquisitions may have changed the product portfolio and geographic reach.
